title: Derivative of the auxiliary derivative expression
statement: Let $L,x\in\mathbb{R}$ and suppose $1-L+Le^{-x}>0$. The function $y\mapsto -L+\frac{y}{4}+\frac{Le^{-y}}{1-L+Le^{-y}}$ has derivative at $x$ equal to $\frac14-\frac{L(1-L)e^{-x}}{(1-L+Le^{-x})^2}$.
replaced:
Let $L, x \in \bbr$ and suppose $1 - L + L\,e^{-x} > 0$. Then the function
\[
  \varphi'(x) \;=\; -L + \frac{x}{4} + \frac{L\,e^{-x}}{1 - L + L\,e^{-x}}
\]
(the derivative from \texttt{bernoulli\_mgf\_bound\_step1}) is differentiable at $x$ with
derivative
\[
  \varphi''(x) \;=\; \frac{1}{4} - \frac{L\,(1 - L)\,e^{-x}}{\bigl(1 - L + L\,e^{-x}\bigr)^2}.
\]
This is the $\varphi''$ computation used in the proof of \texttt{bernoulli\_mgf\_bound}.
